case: Hartford Fire Insurance Company v. Carson Madrona Company, LLC
court: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California
side: third-party defendant / insurer (Ohio Security Insurance Co. and American Fire and Casualty Co.)
motion: Ohio Security and American Fire's motion for partial summary judgment (D.I. 64)
nature: Insurance coverage: which of 4 insurers owes defense and indemnity for a judgment against their common insured
notes: 4 cross-motions decided together. Oppositions to D.I. 64 are inside Hartford's cross-motion (67) and Ace's motion (68). D.I. 79 is a tentative order; D.I. 81 is final.
brief: Ohio Security and American Fire's notice of motion and memorandum (D.I. 64), filed 2025-01-02
outcome: Lost. Hartford's and Ace's motions granted in part; Carson Madrona's and the Liberty parties' (Ohio Security, American Fire) denied (D.I. 81). Endorsement governs, not the coverage form; 'caused, in whole or in part' means proximate cause. Tentative order D.I. 79 said the same.
